summary: Cloud-hosted engine fix: the EXE now opens the S5 editor over GitHub Pages HTTPS before loading Three.js, avoiding the local file/CDN module failure.
notes: Fixes the repeated 3D engine loading failure in the embedded local HTML build.
The Windows EXE now acts as the S5 launcher and opens the full editor from your GitHub Pages app folder.
Three.js modules load from an HTTPS page instead of a local file origin.
Your chain asset server and optional update system remain separate and unchanged.
